description:
Tidy remaining ameba findings from the 0.9.22 review. All are stylistic and auto-fixable:

**`cache.cr` lines 179, 183** — `Lint/VoidOutsideLib`
- `def self.clear : Void` → drop the `Void` annotation (or use `: Nil`)
- `def self.clear_by_prefix(prefix : String) : Void` → same

**`software/github.cr` line 54** — `Lint/UnusedRescueVariable`
- `rescue ex : JSON::ParseException` (where `ex` is unused) → `rescue JSON::ParseException`

**`rss_parser.cr`** — `Style/VerboseBlock` x2 (lines 154, 284) and `Naming/BlockParameterName` x5 (lines 304, 306, 307, 331, 339, 373, 381)
- Auto-fix verbose blocks: `compact_map { |cat| cat.text.try(&.strip).presence }` → `compact_map(&.text.try(&.strip).presence)`
- Rename block parameters: `|cat|`, `|l|`, `|c|` → `|category|`, `|link|`, `|child|` (or similar)

**`software.cr` line 155** — `Style/RedundantNilInControlExpression`
- `return nil if url.bytesize > 500` → `return if url.bytesize > 500`

**`public_suffix.cr` lines 69, 86** — `Style/VerboseBlock`, `Lint/VoidOutsideLib`
- `matches.max_by { |m| m.split('.').size }` → `matches.max_by(&.split('.').size)`
- One `: Void` annotation to drop

Approach:
1. Run `crystal tool format` first.
2. Apply manual edits for the rest.
3. Re-run ameba to confirm zero findings in changed files.
4. Re-run full spec suite to confirm no behavior change.

Acceptance: `ameba` failures drop from 21 → ≤14 (i.e., -7); full spec suite passes.
title: Address remaining ameba findings (Void types, unused rescue, verbose blocks)
